title: RUPP Department of Information Technology Engineering
passages: Undergraduate majors offered by the RUPP Department of Information Technology Engineering, Faculty of Engineering: Information Technology Engineering (ITE), Data Science and Engineering (DSE), and Artificial Intelligence Engineering (AIE). These are the three bachelor degree programs listed under All Programs.
The Department of Information Technology Engineering contact address is Room 302, STEM Building, Royal University of Phnom Penh. The department page lists fe.info@rupp.edu.kh as its contact email.
